name: help
description: Contextual "?" help assistant: one-file client chip/card + public ask route + GCS cache + admin analytics
requires: an LLM provider (for /help/ask, routed via llmGateway)
wiring: 1. Client — drop contextual-help.js into your served public dir, then add one tag per page (idempotent):
<script src="/contextual-help.js?v=1"></script>
Edit the CFG block at the top: appSlug, api.config/ask, langCookie, feedbackUrl (null to hide).
Match CFG.api.* to where you mount the routes (defaults are /api/*; this app mounts under /server).
2. Server — fix the require paths in the copied files (installer copies verbatim):
help.js:      '../services/helpStore'  ->  './helpStore'   (now a sibling in server/help/)
helpStore.js: './storage'              ->  '../services/storage'
Leave '../services/llmGateway', '../middleware/auth', '../utils/language' as-is IF those live in
server/services, server/middleware, server/utils; otherwise repoint to your equivalents.
3. Server — mount the router once (server.js), AFTER cookie-parser and your rate limiter:
const helpRouter = require('./help/help');
app.use('/server', llmLimiter, helpRouter);   // llmLimiter guards the public /help/ask
Routes: GET /config/help-hover (public), POST /help/ask (public), GET /admin/help-analytics (Admin).
4. Swap slots the copied server code expects (see README 'Integration contract'):
storage      -> GCS service exposing getBucket(), isConfigured(), downloadFile(name)
llmGateway   -> { llmGateway } with .chat(messages, opts) (the single LLM chokepoint)
auth         -> { optionalAuth (fn), requireAdmin (middleware array) }
language     -> { LANGUAGE_NAMES } code->name map
5. Optional — bundle a grounding doc at server/data/help-grounding.md (or GCS HELP_GROUNDING_DOC)
to ground "why is this here?" answers; without it the bot answers from the DOM snippet only.
/help/ask + /config/help-hover are PUBLIC by design (chip lives on pre-sign-in pages) but rate-limited.
/admin/help-analytics is Admin-only. Cache + analytics no-op (answer, don't persist) without GCS.
